Set Theory Game
Family Combination World
Level 1 / 8 : Complement of a family union

Don't read the below if you don't want to see solutions yet. :-)

github solution

The solution as given in github uses the following step:

have h3a : tᶜ ∈ {A | Aᶜ ∈ F}

Their whole solution is here:

ext x
apply Iff.intro
intro h1
rewrite [mem_sInter]
intro t h2
rewrite [mem_setOf] at h2
rewrite [mem_compl_iff] at h1
rewrite [mem_sUnion] at h1
push_neg at h1
have h3 := h1 tᶜ h2
rewrite [mem_compl_iff] at h3
push_neg at h3
exact h3
intro h1
rewrite [mem_sInter] at h1
rewrite [mem_compl_iff]
rewrite [mem_sUnion]
push_neg
intro t h2
have h3 := h1 tᶜ
have h3a : tᶜ ∈ {A | Aᶜ ∈ F}
rewrite [mem_setOf]
rewrite [compl_compl]
exact h2
have h4 := h3 h3a
rewrite [mem_compl_iff] at h4
exact h4

alternative solution

There's an alternative solution which doesn't use:

have h3a : tᶜ ∈ {A | Aᶜ ∈ F}

It does use:

rewrite [← mem_compl_iff]

which isn't in the github solution:

ext
apply Iff.intro
intro h1
rewrite [mem_compl_iff] at h1
rewrite [mem_sInter]
intro t
intro h2
rewrite [mem_setOf] at h2
rewrite [mem_sUnion] at h1
push_neg at h1
have h3 := h1 tᶜ
have h4 := h3 h2
rewrite [mem_compl_iff] at h4
push_neg at h4
exact h4
intro h1
rewrite [mem_sInter] at h1
rewrite [mem_compl_iff]
rewrite [mem_sUnion]
push_neg
intro t
intro h2
rewrite [← mem_compl_iff]
have h3 := h1 tᶜ
rewrite [mem_setOf] at h3
rewrite [compl_compl] at h3
have h4 := h3 h2
exact h4

Just wanted to share an alternative approach.
